title: PHASE 3 — rank-mask refresh hardware ablation (real A10 + real TDX, L12 AdamW, signed-perm valid family)

R2_refresh_every1.note: inflated by bf16-forward-noise amplification over 10 basis changes

R3_refresh_every5.note: 2 refreshes -> near bf16 floor; correct refresh preserves

R5_params_only.note: moments left in old basis -> real drift

R6_inconsistent.note: A rebased, B not -> effective dW changes at each refresh -> broken

verdict.R2_R3_correct_signed_perm: PRESERVE the trajectory — loss continuity maintained, converge to <= baseline loss (R2 0.0009, R3 0.0009 vs R1 0.0037); R3 effective adapter near bf16 floor (3% median). Correct state transport works.
verdict.R5_params_only_NEG: measurably DRIFTS — degraded convergence (0.0078) + 80% median adapter drift (moments not rebased).
verdict.R6_inconsistent_NEG: BREAKS — erratic non-monotone loss (jump to 0.71 at step 6, final 0.16) + 131% median adapter divergence (effective dW not preserved).

classification_confirmed_on_hardware: signed-permutation R (Class C) refresh with correct optimizer-state transport preserves the AdamW trajectory; breaking the moment transport (R5) or the effective-dW preservation (R6) measurably fails. Not claimed exact from algebra alone — real artifacts.
NOT_run_this_stage: SGD/momentum refresh variants (Class A/B: any invertible R works; a10_lin_runner refresh hook not added — the EASY case; AdamW signed-perm is the HARD case that motivates Class C and IS validated here)
